Makes the gamma tables that [SetGamma](SetGamma) changed count: the window is shown through them from now on, also if the program only draws to the front buffer and does not [Flip](Flip).
@param calibrate  1 to use the calibration of the display. Defaults to 0.
@gap The original gave the tables to the display. This only changes the window, never the gamma of the display, so nothing outside of the program looks different. `calibrate` has no effect, as no calibration of the display is used.
